long_description: Floreo VR is a user-friendly therapy tool for neurodivergent individuals of all ages and capabilities, designed to teach social, communication, behavioral, and daily life skills through virtual reality. Created in collaboration with educators, clinicians, and game designers, Floreo's lessons are grounded in evidence-based learning principles. The platform puts learners in virtual situations that are difficult to create naturally, such as street crossing safety, social interactions, and emotional regulation practice. A coaching device pairs with the VR headset to stream the learner's view in real-time, enabling clinician guidance. The standalone app also includes calming sensory spaces (an interactive aquarium and crystal cave) for relaxation and focus. Widely used in autism education and support settings, Floreo has been utilized with individuals with ADHD, PTSD, anxiety, and other neurotypes.

faqs.a: Floreo VR is a virtual reality therapy tool for neurodivergent individuals that teaches social, communication, behavioral, and daily life skills through immersive lessons designed by educators and clinicians.
Floreo is designed for neurodivergent individuals of all ages, including those with autism, ADHD, PTSD, and anxiety who need to develop social, communication, and life skills.

Floreo subscriptions cost approximately $50 per student per month. VR headsets can be purchased separately or bundled, and qualifying school districts may receive free Meta Quest headsets through Meta's donation program.

A learner wears a VR headset to experience immersive lessons while a coach monitors in real-time via a paired device. The VR environments allow safe practice of skills that are difficult to create naturally.
